passives.name: Plasma Oscillations
passives.description: (Passive Effect) After any attack, an enemy's Counterattack, Revenge, or Agile Response will not trigger. When hit by a single-target attack, final damage is reduced by [Buff_V_event_monster_buff_514], and Weakness Gauge damage is not taken. Additionally, recovers Weakness Gauge by [Buff_V_event_monster_buff_513]. (Only the highest final damage reduction value applies.) When an enemy uses a skill that is not an attack, they take [Buff_V_event_monster_buff_515] Fixed Damage twice. Each time an enemy takes an action other than Burst Skill/Dual Attack/Skill Chain, DMG dealt by all Dark enemies increases by [Buff_V_event_monster_buff_516_child]. Prevents other AP reduction skills, and AP cost for non-Dark enemies increases by [Buff_V_event_monster_buff_517]. Damage from Curse/Fixed Damage dealt to the Boss cannot exceed [Buff_V_armor_common_3]. All attacks deal more damage the fewer targets there are.
